one_month_reasoning: No ALAB print in the window: the Q3 2026 date is not yet announced (no release found as of Sep 30) and last year's pattern and aggregators point to ~Nov 3-5, after Oct 29. In-window events: (1) the Oct 28 FOMC, where markets price ~70% odds of a 25bp hike (CNBC 2026-09-23, Kalshi) - mostly priced but asymmetric against a ~56x-P/E, 99%-vol name on a hawkish surprise; (2) late-October hyperscaler Q3 prints and 2027 capex commentary, two-sided but the main fundamental read-through (management frames capex as the demand driver; no capex cuts announced); (3) sentiment risk from OpenAI's widened, second training pause (Yahoo Finance 2026-09-28, no restart date). Net: I centre slightly below spot (median ~$354, vs ~$359 in round 1) with a monthly sigma ~24% (up from 22% because of the Fed and sentiment headlines; still below 99%/3.5 = 28% since the company print is outside the window).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS as of Sep-2027 ~$8.30 x 44x = $365, 60%) and EV/NTM sales (~$3.9B x 16x + ~$2.1B net cash over ~192M diluted shares = $334, 40%), giving ~$352, slightly below spot.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q4'26 consensus EPS $1.42 already annualizes to $5.68; FY27 consensus $6.39 looks conservative vs. management commentary that Scorpio X design wins, Scorpio P, custom/NVLink Fusion and Leo CXL all ramp in 2027. I use FY27 ~$6.9 and ~25-30% growth into the following four quarters as gross margin drifts toward the 70% long-term target (guidance/transcripts), giving ~$8.3.

Stock trades ~56x FY27 consensus today ($357.84/$6.39); growth decelerates from ~100% to ~30-40% by late 2027, so I compress to ~45x as in round 1, and take one more turn off (44x) because the Fed is now expected to hike (~70% odds Oct 28, ~91% before 2027), which weighs on long-duration growth multiples.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue as of Sep-2027 ~$3.9B x 16x EV/sales + ~$2.1B net cash, / ~192M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: 10-Q: H1'26 OCF was only $162.3M because receivables rose $109M (to $192.5M) and inventory $53M (to $113.8M); capex $28.1M; no buybacks. With revenue still ramping from $392M to ~$650M+/qtr, working capital keeps absorbing cash, so I assume ~$0.85B of FCF over the next five quarters (vs ~$1.2B in round 1), taking $1.25B to ~$2.1B.
185M diluted guided for Q3'26 plus ~3-4%/yr dilution from RSUs ($640M unrecognized) and customer warrants (3.26M 2026 warrant plus earlier tranches).
FY27 consensus $2.97B; I assume ~$3.2B FY27 and ~$3.9B for Q4'27-Q3'28 as Scorpio X broadens to additional customers (engagements now high-teens).
Current EV ~ $65B on ~$2.6B Q4'26 run-rate (~25x run-rate, ~22x FY27 consensus); compressing to 16x NTM as growth slows toward 30%, consistent with ~70% gross margins and ~40%+ operating margin.

bear.story: AI capex digestion in 2027 and/or Scorpio X losing sockets to NVLink Fusion/Broadcom scale-up Ethernet; top-3 customer concentration (69% of Q2 revenue) bites, growth stalls near the Q4'26 run-rate, EPS ~$6.5 and multiple de-rates to ~30x, helped by a hiking Fed and frontier-lab training pauses. Base rate: ALAB fell 68% in Jan-Apr 2025.

base.story: Scorpio X broadens to more hyperscalers, P-Series/Leo/custom ramp in 2027 as guided; FY27 EPS ~$6.9, NTM EPS ~$8.3 at ~44-46x; gross margin drifts toward 70%; net cash ~$2.1B.

bull.story: Content per XPU exceeds $1,000 and UALink (native Trainium4 racks)/NVLink Fusion custom wins land; revenue >$3.6B in FY27 (top of consensus range), NTM EPS ~$10 at ~57x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$210 the stock would trade at ~33x FY27 consensus EPS of $6.39, a level that only makes sense if the market believed the Scorpio X ramp or 2027 hyperscaler programs had slipped or been lost (a Q4 guide at or below the ~$550M Q3 level, a lost or double-sourced AWS socket, or one of the top-3 customers cutting orders) or real hyperscaler capex cuts, not sentiment swings. Fed hikes and training-pause headlines alone should not take it there.

key_uncertainties: Durability of hyperscaler AI capex into 2027-2028
Customer concentration: top three direct customers were 69% of Q2 2026 revenue
Competition from Nvidia NVLink and Broadcom in scale-up fabrics and PCIe switching
Gross margin dilution from module mix (guide 72%, long-term target 70%)
Multiple compression as growth decelerates from ~100% y/y
Rates: a hiking Fed (Oct 28 and into 2027) compresses long-duration growth multiples
Frontier-lab training pauses and AI-slowdown sentiment (Sep 14 selloff) without capex cuts so far
reasoning: Round 2. Primary documents still show an extraordinary ramp: Q2 2026 revenue $392.4M (+104% y/y), Q3 guide $540-560M and EPS $1.16-1.21, Scorpio X now the largest line (8-K, call). The 10-Q adds that top-3 customers are 69% of revenue, $640M of unrecognized RSU expense, the Feb 2026 AWS warrant (3.26M shares at $142.82 vesting on up to $6.5B cumulative purchases through 2033 - a ceiling, not a backlog), and, re-read for round 2, that H1 OCF of $162.3M was held down by a $109M receivables and $53M inventory build, so I cut Sep-2027 net cash from $2.5B to ~$2.1B (supervisor finding, verified in the 10-Q). I accept the supervisor's other findings: the Oct 28 FOMC (~70% hike odds) and OpenAI's widened training pause fall in or near the window, and the Trainium4/NVLink Fusion news is from Dec 2025 and priced. I take one turn off the P/E multiple (45x to 44x) for the hiking Fed. Fair value moves from $360 to ~$352 (P/E $365, EV/sales $334), about spot. Scenarios bear $200 / base $380 / bull $580 at 25/50/25 give a mean ~$385. Ladder: lognormal with median ~$360 (was $372) and sigma ~0.67, with a slightly fatter far-left tail (P>=89 0.97) for ALAB's own -68% 2025 drawdown and the missing skeptic lane, and a trimmed upper tail (P>=626 0.20 vs 0.22) per supervisor feedback. I do not move the median below spot: consensus FY27 EPS ($6.39) still looks conservative against a Q4'26 run-rate of $5.68 and no hyperscaler has cut capex. Round-2 research was tight: two web searches (no Q3 date or new company news found) and a re-read of the 10-Q.
